system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Sex and age are upstream demographic attributes. Age can influence education and employment status. City size is a contextual condition that can affect transport choice. Transport mode is likely the most downstream behavioral outcome among these variables. Education and employment are placed after age as typical life-course consequences, though this is only a prior, not ground truth.
